cards.card_text: Rebellion is like the sin of divination, he says, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.
cards.verse_text: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.
cards.snippet: …like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.

cards.card_text: Jezebel's idolatry and witchcraft Joram's alliance with Judah The war with Hazael of Aram
cards.verse_text: When Joram saw Jehu, he asked, “Have you come in peace, Jehu?” “How can there be peace,” he replied, “as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?”
cards.snippet: …Jehu?” “How can there be peace,” he replied, “as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?”

cards.card_text: When any Israelite with idols in his heart comes to the prophet, the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry.
cards.verse_text: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,
cards.snippet: …the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,

cards.card_text: God says all the women will be admonished not to imitate the sisters, and the sisters will bear the consequences of their sins of idolatry.
cards.verse_text: They will repay you for your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry.
cards.snippet: …your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry.

cards.card_text: He calls the Corinthians his beloved, and he tells them what to do about idolatry.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
cards.snippet: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

cards.card_text: After all those warnings from Israel's history, what does Paul tell his beloved to do about idolatry?
cards.verse_text: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
cards.snippet: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

cards.card_text: Then comes the list: sexual immorality, idolatry, sorcery, hatred, jealousy, rage, rivalries, envy, drunkenness and more.
cards.verse_text: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery; idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions, and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like.
cards.snippet: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery; idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions, and envy;…

cards.card_text: In his list of things to put to death, Paul calls greed idolatry.
cards.verse_text: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
cards.snippet: …earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.

cards.card_text: Peter tells them they've spent enough time already carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.
cards.verse_text: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
cards.snippet: …as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
